_README: Cassettes whose prompt has changed since they were recorded, so the recording no
longer answers the question the tool now asks. A cassette listed here is STALE:
the command it backs reports itself NOT EVALUATED and exits non-zero, and the
test suite holds it to exactly that rather than letting it pass quietly.
Every entry is dated, owned and expiring, the same shape the portfolio uses for
waivers. An entry accepts exactly one cassette. tests/test_ai_walkthrough.py
fails if a cassette is stale and NOT listed here (silence), if a cassette is
listed here and is in fact fresh (a stale entry outliving its cause), or if the
date below has passed (a re-record deferred indefinitely).
Removing an entry is part of re-recording, not a separate decision: once the
recording matches the current prompt, the entry must go or the suite fails.
